unit: one $1000+ taker sample per game, dollar-weighted entry vs 10-minute VWAP close
close: vwap of the 10 minutes before kickoff, else 30 minutes, else the last trade

rule.note: Labeled sharp at t>=3. q is Benjamini-Hochberg on the tested wallets and is not the live gate.

study.note: Skill persists, but the edge is gone within about 30 minutes of the trade; by kickoff the price has priced it in. Context only, not a bet to copy.
